description: A seabird colony by day: its birds' calls, perMinute a minute from each colony, heard within reach metres. Gannets' harsh 'arrah', a rasp of a falling tone; boobies' whistles, short and high; frigatebirds' rattle, a pitch beaten rate times a second (the colonies' calls as BirdLife and the Cornell Lab describe them). Frequencies in Hz, times in seconds, levels as gains.
